notes.title: Demo is live! (also, join our Discord)
notes.notes:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45612170/e3d0b6e4fb63aa82522f6c58da5345516b7e96e9.jpg"][/img][/p][p]It took a bit longer than expected, but the demo is finally here![/p][p]It includes:[/p][list][*][p]20 cards to play around with[/p][/*][*][p]3 levels with unique biomes[/p][/*][*][p]lots of upgrades[/p][/*][/list][p]Two game modes:[/p][list][*][p]Default (campaign) mode - launch countless expeditions to conquer all three levels, gradually unlocking cards and upgrades[/p][/*][*][p]Custom mode - play your favourite level with all the cards unlocked from the start, so you can experiment with different builds with no restrictions![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]The demo is available here: 
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3731740/Into_The_Depths_Demo/"][/dynamiclink][/p][p]Also, join the [url="https://discord.gg/rw4nQCgted"]Discord server[/url]! Feel free to share your thoughts or suggest some ideas there! (though you can do it here or by writing a review if you want)[/p][p][/p][p]Expect more updates in the future![/p]

notes.title: Some updates about the game
notes.notes: [p]Hi everyone! It's been a while since this game's page was launched, but I haven't posted any updates here. Time to change that! Here goes the first post (don't expect a lot)[/p][p][/p][h1]New Mechanics[/h1][p]I've added some stuff to do in between the runs: deckbuilding and permanent upgrades. With this you can get creative and come up with some unique strategies for the following run![/p][h3]Preview of deckbuilding screen[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45612170/4327c9e0a7555ccfbc38fc88c2b9056e1c21a73e.jpg"][/img][/p][h1]Updated visuals[/h1][p]The game UI was completely revamped! Old tiles are now replaced with proper cards (yes, it's a card game to some extent now). They are more informative and, more importantly, are much cuter than tile buttons we had before! Instead of boring gray panels, now we have this cozy and warm yellowish design. See it yourself![/p][h3]Updated game UI:[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45612170/4a30909ef26de811d2c75aadec1c4186a20a709c.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]New main menu:[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45612170/e788bc42b7b892130ab045cb93743f22a7712928.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Level-up reward screen:[/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45612170/061a8d36c83fee78fe1b2b0af5ecb868988ad0cf.jpg"][/img][/p][p][/p][h1]Demo (!!!)[/h1][p]Hopefully, the demo will be released in the next two weeks, or I'll have to write some sorry apology.[/p][p][/p][p]That's all the news for now! I'll try to post more here from now on, so stay tuned![/p]
